label: HTTP: run request at cursor
command:
if ! command -v zed-http >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: zed-http was not found on PATH. It is required to run HTTP requests.' 'Install it from the repository checkout root with: cargo install --path cli --locked' 'Documentation: https://github.com/JimPr/http-client#install-the-cli' 'No request was sent.' >&2
  exit 127
fi
zed-http "$ZED_FILE" --line "$((ZED_ROW + 1))" --use-default-environment --project-root "$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT"
